anya: Heads-up — roadmap review needs a concise playbook for Optimize: batching/caching/quant recs + eval-triggered alerts. Can we produce a 1-pager with launch gates? :hourglass:
priya: I'll draft acceptance metrics: perf/cost/quality/reliability. Short bullets inline.
mike: Runtime constraints: p95 <= +5% and fallback < 500ms. I'll add CI tests for fallback.
jenna: I'll recruit 2 pilots (acme-health, scribble-ai). Need consent text and onboarding checklist.
sam: Eval alerts split into regression vs drift. Propose 5% regression over 1h = hard alert; drift = info. Retention: 90d aggregates, 30d samples.
leo: Phase plan: (1) Advisor read-only recs, (2) Ops pilot manual-apply, (3) Auto-apply opt-in after 30d stable.
anya: Decision check: manual apply for first 6 weeks. Auto later if metrics hold. Agree?
priya: Agreed. I'll post the one-pager by EOD with clear pass/fail criteria.
mike: I'll publish a minimal rec API spec including concordance_estimate and eval_snapshot_id.
deploy-bot: Note: playbook spec v0.3 uploaded to /docs/playbooks/optimize (jenna).
